scope_gate: Material changes require a ChangeEnvelope with delta, affected_surfaces, invariants, out_of_scope, compatibility, regression_surface and rollback. Unmentioned elements are preserved; deletion, contract break or expansion requires new Intent or explicit authority.
design_system_gate: Before implementing an interface, inspect the component catalog and record a component_reuse_assessment choosing reuse, extend, create, local or not_applicable with rationale and consumer surfaces. Creation requires a stable contract and plausible reuse; one-off feature rules remain local.
model_routing: Use the least expensive capable model after risk classification; declare ceilings and reuse fresh evidence only when observed dependencies are unchanged.
quality_gate: All applicable mandatory scenarios require fresh passing evidence; waivers are scoped, compensating and expiring.
exposure_gate: Consumers project people, operations, economic value and data exposed during RTO/RPO; the worst dimension drives evolution while safety floors remain independent of volume.
forbidden_inferences: Stale evidence proves the current revision
Silence authorizes removal or behavior change
A nearby refactor belongs to the requested delta
